title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-11

ai_review.summary: Stellar soundboard capture of a legendary show highlighted by an all‑star Lovelight duet and an epic, laid‑back Dark Star/Spanish Jam despite some tinny quirks.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the historic guest appearance of Greg Allman and Pigpen on Lovelight and the uncut, sprawling Dark Star that rolls into one of the best Spanish Jams ever recorded. The soundboard source is generally clear and well‑balanced, though a few reviewers note a tinny, harsh edge early in the set that could use EQ.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for musical performance and multiple 5‑star reviews outweigh modest technical complaints, yielding an overall rating in the excellent range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp SBD with occasional tinny/harsh character that benefits from EQ; source switches add interesting texture but no major drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set shines with Lovelight featuring Allman/Pigpen, followed by a relaxed, extended Dark Star that morphs into the celebrated Spanish Jam, giving the concert a flowing, jam‑centric climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar work is described as mesmerizing and perfectly suited to the mellow Dark Star vibe.
